intro k hr
have h1 : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ↑n * p n) Filter.atTop (nhds r) := hr
have h2 : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => p n) Filter.atTop (nhds (r / ↑k.factorial)) :=
  by refine Filter.Tendsto.cong' _ (by simp [div_eq_mul_left, mul_assoc])
  exact Filter.Tendsto.mul_right (Filter.Tendsto.div_right h1 (by simp [mul_comm]))
have h3 : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => p n ^ k) Filter.atTop (nhds (r ^ k)) :=
  by refine Filter.Tendsto.pow' _ (by simp [pow_div])
  exact h2
refine Filter.Tendsto.mul_right _ h3
exact Filter.Tendsto.mul_right (Filter.Tendsto.mul_left h1 (by simp [mul_comm])) (by simp [mul_assoc])
